title: better-auth 0.4.12-beta.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an improper authentication…
description: An improper authentication vulnerability exists in better-auth versions 0.4.12-beta.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 in the phone number plugin. This flaw allows sign-up and other flows to save unverified phone numbers, which are then used by phone OTP sign-in to select accounts. An attacker can exploit this by associating a victim's phone number with an attacker-controlled account, causing the victim's valid OTP sign-in to yield a session for the attacker's account and potentially exposing data the victim enters.
